```json
{
  "up": {
    "Select": [
      "compound_chembl_id",
      "canonical_smiles",
      "compound_key",
      "pubmed_id_or_doi",
      "assay_description",
      "standard_type",
      "standard_relation",
      "standard_value",
      "standard_units",
      "activity_comment",
      "target_chembl_id",
      "target_name",
      "target_organism"
    ],
    "Source": [
      "molecule_dictionary",
      "molecule_hierarchy",
      "compound_records",
      "compound_structures",
      "activities",
      "assays",
      "docs",
      "target_dictionary"
    ],
    "Join": [
      "molecule_dictionary parent ON parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1336'",
      "molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno",
      "molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno",
      "compound_records r ON child.molregno = r.molregno",
      "compound_structures cs ON child.molregno = cs.molregno",
      "activities act ON r.record_id = act.record_id",
      "assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id",
      "docs d ON r.doc_id = d.doc_id",
      "target_dictionary t ON act.tid = t.tid"
    ],
    "Filter": [
      "t.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL279'",
      "act.standard_type = 'IC50'",
      "act.standard_units = 'nM'"
    ],
    "Sort": [
      "compound_chembl_id ASC",
      "compound_key ASC",
      "pubmed_id_or_doi ASC",
      "assay_description ASC",
      "standard_type ASC",
      "standard_relation ASC",
      "standard_value ASC",
      "standard_units ASC",
      "target_chembl_id ASC",
      "target_name ASC",
      "target_organism ASC"
    ],
    "Limit": "none"
  }
}
```
